==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Display was introduced in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5]], which was published in [[February]] [[1995]]. The feature was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="GNN" />
